candidate: D: official-style worked example, duplicate/no-output feedback, thinking, 180-second episode
public_trace_findings: The example and feedback nearly eliminated exact repetition, but long reasoning/code reduced throughput to 5.8 actions per episode.
The previous-song task reached a Luna Starlight song after four verified navigation iterations, then timed out before complete_task.
The queue task incorrectly used play_music instead of add_to_queue and failed to filter query results to the requested artist.
The artist-extremum task spent its remaining turns on additional docs instead of calling the already-discovered search_songs endpoint.
Several actions used invalid page_limit=50 or assumed id/artist fields despite observed schemas, demonstrating remaining schema-following errors.
decision: Reject D and stop prompt-only expansion. Run the original concise react-v2 prompt with the engineering/completion fixes to measure whether prompt revisions caused the throughput/quality regression. Preserve the near-complete navigation trace as evidence that finalization latency still matters after correct effects.
